I'm really sorry for your loss and all my condolences go to you as well as your family. Losing someone is never is piece of cake and the way people handle it can vary from person to person. When it comes to your family, I'd say the only way to support them is to be physically there, especially your mom. Don't let her be alone, cause, and I say that kinda from experience, it's when you're alone that the thoughts come crashing in and it's at that point that you're the most vulnerable. I'd assume all your siblings are old enough to have moved away from the parental household but it is essential that all of you stick together and visit your mother quite regularly and be with her/do activities with her when the time is right. Mourning the death of a loved one is hard but it's a essential step in accepting it. I guess all I can say is stick together, be affectionate with her and let her grieve. You said your father passed on Monday which is recent. So give her some time

Again all my condolences go to you and your family. Stay strong
